summary: One key on a VirtualKeyboard: a lowercase and uppercase character paired with a Button.
overview: A single key. It holds the two characters and relabels itself when shift changes; the keyboard owns the shift state and the typing, so this reports clicks and nothing more.
useCases: Building a custom keyboard layout key by key.
A numeric or symbol pad reusing the same key component.

gotchas.title: It does not type anything itself
gotchas.body: It reports a click to the keyboard, which decides what the character is given shift state. A key with no keyboard above it does nothing.
